title: WS-049 - Glossary for EUSurvey Web-services API integrations
intent: Define key terms used in the EUSurvey Web-services API specification.
short_answer: The EUSurvey Web-services API uses several recurring terms. A Guest List is a collection of individual accesses to a survey. A List ID identifies a guest list. A Ticket identifies an asynchronous request. A Token represents an individual access to a secured survey and allows one contribution. A Token List is a guest list containing anonymous token accesses.
procedure: Use Guest List when discussing collections of contacts or anonymous accesses to a survey.
Use List ID when calling token-list endpoints.
Use Ticket when polling for asynchronous results.
Use Token when granting individual access to a secured survey.
Use Token List when managing many anonymous token accesses through the API.
important_conditions: The API currently offers token-related guest-list creation and management through the Invitations API.
